resource.name: APIError-Unauthorised
resource.description: An example of an OperationOutcome resource representing an unauthorised access error.

resource.name: Authorization Case Count
resource.description: The number of authorization cases or approval criteria specified in the authorization requirement. This indicates how many different clinical scenarios or conditions have distinct approval pathways.

resource.name: Authorization Form
resource.description: The special authorization form code required for this medication (e.g., 'SA2535'). This identifies the specific PHARMAC authorization form that prescribers must complete for patient eligibility.

resource.name: Authorization Schema
resource.description: Base64-encoded JSON Schema that defines the structure and validation rules for a Special Authorization application form. The decoded content is a JSON Schema (application/schema+json).

resource.name: Authorization Title
resource.description: A human-readable title for the authorization requirement (e.g., 'Budesonide - Special Authorization Required'). This provides context for the authorization need.

resource.name: Brand Switch Fee
resource.description: Indicates whether a brand switch fee applies for this item.

resource.description: Rules for Clexane 100 mg in 1 ml syringe - Case 3.

resource.name: Clexane - Pricing
resource.description: Pricing information for Clexane (enoxaparin sodium injection). Demonstrates fully subsidized community and HML pricing.

resource.name: Contract Type
resource.description: Type of PHARMAC contract that applies to this item (for example, sole-supply, preferred).

resource.name: Cost Brand Source
resource.description: Indicates whether pricing for this item is sourced from a cost brand.

resource.name: Daily Volume Limit Percent
resource.description: Percentage daily volume limit that applies to this item.

resource.name: Device Definition Reference
resource.description: Reference to a DeviceDefinition that this pricing applies to. Used because ChargeItemDefinition.instance can only reference Device, Medication, or Substance instances, not DeviceDefinition. For Medication, use ChargeItemDefinition.instance directly.

resource.name: Funding Rule
resource.description: Funding rules that define medication and device funding conditions, restrictions, and special requirements

resource.name: In-Combination
resource.description: Indicates whether this item is only subsidised when used in combination with other medicines or treatments.

resource.name: Medication ATC Category 1
resource.description: Used to describe ATC Category 1 (including id and name)

resource.name: Medication ATC Category 2
resource.description: Used to describe ATC Category 2 (including id and name)

resource.name: Medication ATC Category 3
resource.description: Used to describe ATC Category 3 (including id and name)

resource.name: Medication Brand Name
resource.description: The brand or trade name of the medication. For example, 'Budesonide Te Arai' or 'Gaviscon Infant'.

resource.name: Medication In Combination
resource.description: Indicates whether this medication is only subsidised when used in combination with other medicines.

resource.name: Medication Legal Classification
resource.description: Legal classification for a medication.

resource.name: Medication Original Pack
resource.description: Indicates whether this pack represents the original pack supplied by the manufacturer.

resource.name: Medication Package Size
resource.description: Package size for a scheduled medication. For example, '30 x 650 mg sachets' would be represented as 'Sachet' in the form property and 30 in the packageSize extension property.

resource.name: Medication Product Created Date
resource.description: The date a medication product record was created.

resource.name: Medication Product Multiple
resource.description: Indicates whether this pack uses product multiples when calculating pricing or claims.

resource.name: Medication Product Multiplier
resource.description: Numeric multiplier applied when calculating pricing or claims for this pack.

resource.name: Medication Rank
resource.description: Ranking or priority of this medication formulation within the schedule. Lower numbers typically indicate higher priority or preferred formulations.

resource.name: Medication Safety List Medicine
resource.description: Indicates whether this medication is on a PHARMAC safety list.

resource.name: Medication Statim
resource.description: Indicates whether stat (urgent) dispensing rules apply for this medication.

resource.name: Medication Strength
resource.description: Strength for a medication.

resource.name: Medication Unit of Measure
resource.description: The unit of measure used for this medication. For example, 'tab' (tablet), 'cap' (capsule), 'ml' (milliliter), 'sach' (sachet).

resource.name: Medication-Clexane-100mg-1ml-Syringe
resource.description: Medication representation of Clexane (enoxaparin sodium) Inj 100 mg in 1 ml syringe.

resource.name: Medication-Fortisip-Multi-Fibre-Chocolate
resource.description: Supplmentrepresentation of Fortisip Multi Fibre (chocolate) oral feed with fibre 1.5 kcal/ml.

resource.name: Medication-Nutrison-800-Complete-Multi-Fibre
resource.description: Supplement representation of Nutrison 800 Complete Multi Fibre (enteral feed with fibre 0.83 kcal/ml).

resource.name: MedicationBrandNameSearchParam
resource.description: Search for medications by brand name (e.g., 'Gaviscon', 'Acidex', 'Budesonide'). Enables fuzzy matching on the medication-brand-name extension for discovery by product name.

resource.name: MedicationCategorySearchParam
resource.description: Search for medications by category

resource.name: MedicationNameSearchParam
resource.description: Search for medications by the text representation of the medication code (e.g., 'Gaviscon Infant', 'Acidex oral liquid'). Enables discovery by the full medication name or formulation description.

resource.name: PHARMAC Charge Item Definition
resource.description: Profile for ChargeItemDefinition resources representing pricing, subsidy, and rules for devices and medications in the PHARMAC schedule. This profile allows FHIR consumers to use the _include search parameter to retrieve pricing information alongside device or medication resources.

resource.name: PHARMAC Charge Item Definition - Funding Rules
resource.description: Profile for ChargeItemDefinition resources representing funding mechanisms and reimbursement rules in the PHARMAC schedule. This profile captures funding conditions, provider requirements, endorsement criteria, case sequences, and funding mechanism types (Prescription, BSO, Rural PSO, etc.).

resource.name: PHARMAC Charge Item Definition - Pricing
resource.description: Profile for ChargeItemDefinition resources representing product pricing information for medications and devices in the PHARMAC schedule. This profile captures listed prices, PHARMAC subsidies, patient co-payments, and pricing-specific attributes such as contract type, DV limits, and statim requirements.

resource.name: PHARMAC Charge Item Definition - Special Authority
resource.description: Profile for ChargeItemDefinition resources representing Special Authorization (SA) requirements and clinical eligibility criteria in the PHARMAC schedule. This profile captures SA codes, authorization case counts, clinical eligibility, and references to medications requiring special authorization.

resource.name: PHARMAC Medication
resource.description: Profile for Medication resources representing pharmaceutical products in the PHARMAC schedule. This profile defines the structure for medications including brand identification, pack codes, product names, form, and ingredients. Pricing information is provided via related ChargeItemDefinition resources that can be retrieved using the _include search parameter.

resource.name: PHARMAC Medication Code ValueSet
resource.description: ValueSet containing medication codes from NZMT CTPP, PackID, and SNOMED CT code systems used for PHARMAC pharmaceutical schedule medications.

resource.name: Pharmac Schedules Capability Statement
resource.description: Pharmac Schedules Capability Statement. This FHIR resource declares the capabilities of the Pharmac Schedules FHIR API, including supported interactions, resources, and security mechanisms.

resource.name: Pricing Co-Payment Max
resource.description: Indicates whether Co-Payment Max applies to this pricing record.

resource.name: Pricing Effective Date
resource.description: The date from which this pricing becomes effective.

resource.name: Pricing Expiry Date
resource.description: The date on which this pricing expires or ceases to be valid.

resource.name: Pricing Not Combined
resource.description: Indicates whether Not Combined applies to this pricing record.

resource.name: Pricing Section 29
resource.description: Indicates whether Section 29 applies to this pricing record.

resource.name: SearchSet-Bundle-All-Special-Authorities

resource.name: Statim (Urgent Dispensing)
resource.description: Indicates whether stat (urgent) dispensing rules apply for this item.

resource.name: Wastage Claimable
resource.description: Indicates whether wastage for this item may be claimed.
